{{TOC|side}}
A comment is an annotation in the scenario. It is a virtual entity which only exists in the editor and has no effect on the scenario playthrough.

== Placing Comments ==
To place a comment, click the '''right mouse button''' on an empty space and select the '''Place Comment''' option. This will create the comment and open its [[Eden_Editor:_Entity_Attributes|attributes editing window]], where you can set a title and a tooltip.
[[File:3den comment.gif|center]]

== Editing Comments ==
A comment can be edited like any other entity. You can drag it around, copy and paste it, move it to layers, delete it, etc. It can also be saved to [[Eden_Editor:_Custom_Composition|custom compositions]], where it can help explain some aspects of the composition.
